resources.string: Shows a cursor you aim with your Galaxy Watch and taps where it points. It does not read screen content.
Cursor service: off. Enable \"Air Mouse\" under Accessibility → Installed apps.

On the watch: open Air Mouse and press Start. Hold the watch facing you:
• Roll your wrist: cursor up/down
• Raise/lower your elbow: cursor left/right

• Tap watch screen: click
• Hold: long press
• Swipe up/down or turn bezel: scroll
• ◁ ○ □: Back, Home, Recents

Cursor going the wrong way? Press Calibrate on the watch while paused.

Cursor hides after 10 s idle; move your wrist to bring it back.
